detail: Second-pass checker: checker-C, not the extracting agent. Macedonian keyword screen and whole law read; items compared with every provision touched by 163/21 and 86/25. No item added under LIM-0019. Unamended provisions bearing on EU workers or the theme stay out and are reported to the lead: Art. 5(2) point 1, Art. 3, Art. 4(6), Art. 5(5), Art. 10(1), Art. 20, Art. 21(1) and (2). Art. 11(2) is touched by 86/25 Art. 5 but repeats Art. 11(1), so it is not needed.
